content.name: Katharina Brandt
content.title: Senior Data Scientist
content.summary: Data scientist with eight years in insurance, mobility and medical technology, holding an M.Sc. in Mathematics from TUM. Now lead predictive maintenance modelling for imaging devices at a Munich medtech company, where early fault detection reduced unplanned service visits by 21%. Experienced in documenting models for regulated environments and working under GDPR.

experience.title: Senior Data Scientist
bullets: Lead predictive maintenance modelling for 4,200 installed imaging devices; anomaly alerts from sensor logs have reduced unplanned service visits by 21%.
Coordinate a cross-functional team of two data scientists, a data engineer and three service engineers, owning the workstream's quarterly goals.
Wrote model documentation and validation reports aligned with the quality management system, passing an external audit without major findings.
Saved roughly €380,000 a year in spare parts logistics by forecasting part failures per region.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Developed dynamic pricing models for a car-sharing fleet of 1,600 vehicles, raising utilisation by 9% without hurting customer satisfaction scores.
Built a damage detection classifier on return photos that cut manual review time by 40%.
Introduced MLflow tracking and code review for the team of five, making experiments reproducible.

experience.title: Junior Data Scientist
bullets: Modelled claim frequency for household contents insurance using GLMs and gradient boosting together with the actuarial department.
Created a text classifier for incoming German-language claim emails, routing 70% of them automatically to the right team.
Presented model results in German to the underwriting committee every quarter.

education.degree: M.Sc. Mathematics (focus: statistics and machine learning)

achievements.title: Patent application co-inventor
achievements.detail: Named co-inventor on a company patent application for sensor-based fault prediction (2025).

achievements.title: Meetup organiser
achievements.detail: Co-organise a Munich machine learning meetup with around 60 attendees per session.
